messages:
Sam: pushed a follow-up to PR #423 — split flaky tests into unit/integration, bumped pytest, and removed the nondeterministic time-based assertion. PTAL when you have ~10–15m; aiming to canary tomorrow morning.
Sam: main changes are under tests/integration/*, plus a small migration for the kv schema (see migration/001-add-checksum.sql). I left a short runbook in the PR description.
Sam: git commands to try locally if useful:
```
# run only integration tests that used to fail
pytest tests/integration/test_sharding.py -q -k "not flaky"
# run migration locally
psql $DEV_DB < migration/001-add-checksum.sql
```

Priya: taking a look now. Quick Q — the migration touches the DB column that Dedicated infra uses. Did you add a guard so older runtimes don't break? :thinking:
Sam: yes — migration adds column with DEFAULT and we backfill in the same txn; runtime checks for NULL and uses old behavior. Also added a feature-flag gate: REDWOOD_KV_CHECKSUM=true in canary only.
Luca: LGTM on the test split. What's the canary window and rollback criteria? Need to coordinate with oncall.
Sam: planning 1h canary (09:00–10:00 UTC), auto-rollback if error rate spike >2% or median p99 latency regress >150ms. Oncall notified in the PR.
Maya: quick nits — please squash the fixups into the original commit and make the commit message mention the kv migration link to the runbook. Otherwise fine from my side :+1:
Sam: will squash before merge. Also I opened a separate cherry-pick PR to stable branch (will bump the migration id) — assigning @Priya for conflicts check.
Priya: got it, I'll review the cherry-pick PR after this one. If there are conflicts I can take it and resolve.
Luca: one more: any risk for Dedicated reserved pools during the migration? We should ensure capacity isn't affected.
Sam: no expected capacity impact — migration is metadata-only and fast. Added a compatibility check in smoke tests to ensure no slow path.
Priya: PTAL note — added a short integration snippet in the top-level README to help infra QA run the smoke locally.
Sam: thanks! tagging for merge slot: planning to merge at 08:00 UTC tomorrow to allow deploy prep. If CI stays green and no objections, I'll merge then.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for PR #423: canary window 2024-06-05T09:00:00Z -> 2024-06-05T10:00:00Z, tracked by rollout-2024-06-05-423. Notifying oncall.
Maya: thanks — will keep an eye on alerts during the canary window.
Sam: appreciate it. If anyone sees anything odd in the next few hours, ping me here and I'll hold the merge.
